lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: So, you actually fought your way through the castle gates...

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Naruto! Step aside, I need to reach the throne room.

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: I can't let you do that. A real shinobi never backs down from guarding this fortress!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: If that's the case, I'll carve my way through!

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: Let's see if you can break my defense! Believe it!
